Name: Fallout Mole Rat
Author: mightygaspar
Description:
Inspired by the various fallout mods, I cobbled together this mole rat mod.
Mole rat sprites comes from the excellent dwarven expansion mod by mytigo found here https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22021
The truffle/oil sprites plus some code comes from the awesome void pig mod by AngelTear found here https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21478

I'm not really a modder so there likely won't be any updates.  If you like this mod or wish to improve or incorporate it in a project ask mytigo and angeltear.  I made no assets for this mod.

Downloads.Description: Adds Mole Rat and irradiated truffle/oil
